_comment: Global pipeline settings. Edit these rather than the code.
_duration_comment: Sessions are not timed in the chat export, so duration is normalised. default_duration_minutes is applied to every session; Stopped_At = Created_Date + Duration_Minutes.
_overrides_comment: Per-session duration overrides, keyed by the session date (YYYY-MM-DD in local timezone). Use for sessions you know ran long or short.
_labels_comment: Line labels that introduce the work being read. The club has used all of these over the years - 'Tale' was used exclusively through the March-May 2025 run, so dropping it loses 17 sessions.
_author_fields_comment: Line labels that name the author, used when the work line has no 'by <Author>' part.
_segment_comment: A trailing '(...)' on a title is treated as the chapter/part that was read only if it contains a digit or one of these words. Otherwise it is kept as part of the title, so 'The Promise (Dui Bondhu)' stays intact.
_bad_readers_comment: Reader values that mean 'nobody assigned yet'. Compared case-insensitively after cleaning.
bad_readers: to be decided in the session
